script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.lease_owner, (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, j.row_version,
       j.attempt_count, j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.request_payload, j.is_deleted,
       CAST(li.id AS CHAR) AS linked_ida, li.stock_movement_no AS linked_ida_no, CAST(li.stock_movement_no_type AS CHAR) AS linked_ida_no_type
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_DPguard.data.jobId}}
  LEFT JOIN sm_item_disassembly li
    ON li.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND li.id = (SELECT MAX(g.id) FROM sm_item_disassembly g
                 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND g.ida_v2_job_id = '{{node:code_node_DPguard.data.jobId}}' AND g.item_disassembly_status = 'Processing' AND g.is_deleted = 0
                   AND COALESCE((SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
                                  WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = (CONCAT('IDC|', CAST(g.id AS CHAR)) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
                                    AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
                                  ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1), j.idempotency_key) = j.idempotency_key)

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(h.id AS CHAR) AS ida_id, h.item_disassembly_status, h.ida_v2_job_id AS ida_v2_job_id, h.stock_movement_no,
       (SELECT p.result_ref
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'IDC|{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.idaId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref,
       (SELECT p.step_name
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'IDC|{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.idaId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_step
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN sm_item_disassembly h
    ON h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_node_DPentry.data.idaId}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(i.id AS CHAR), 'material_code', i.material_code, 'material_name', i.material_name,
       'stock_control', i.stock_control, 'serial_number_management', i.serial_number_management,
       'item_batch_management', i.item_batch_management, 'batch_number_genaration', i.batch_number_genaration,
       'material_costing_method', i.material_costing_method, 'purchase_unit_price', CAST(i.purchase_unit_price AS CHAR),
       'based_uom', CAST(i.based_uom AS CHAR), 'item_category', i.item_category, 'item_group_id', i.item_group_id,
       'table_uom_conversion', COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('alt_uom_id', CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR), 'base_qty', u.base_qty))
                                   FROM item_mji552rc_sub u
                                  WHERE u.Item_id = i.id AND u.is_deleted = 0), JSON_ARRAY())) AS j
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.id IN (SELECT h.item_id
                  FROM sm_item_disassembly h
                 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_DPentry.data.idaId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0
                UNION
                SELECT CAST(l.item_selection AS UNSIGNED)
                  FROM sm_item_disassembly_tlm8ve69_sub l
                 WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_item_disassembly_id = {{node:code_node_DPentry.data.idaId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0
                   AND l.item_selection REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,20}$')

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(b.id AS CHAR), 'bin', b.bin_location_combine) AS j
  FROM bin_location b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
   AND b.id IN (SELECT l.location_id
                  FROM sm_item_disassembly_tlm8ve69_sub l
                 WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_item_disassembly_id = {{node:code_node_DPentry.data.idaId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0
                UNION
                SELECT CAST(t.loc AS UNSIGNED)
                  FROM sm_item_disassembly h
                  JOIN JSON_TABLE(IF(JSON_VALID(h.temp_qty_data), h.temp_qty_data, '[]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (loc VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.location_id')) t
                 WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_DPentry.data.idaId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0
                   AND t.loc REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,20}$')

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(b.id AS CHAR), 'batch_number', b.batch_number, 'material_id', CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR),
       'plant_id', CAST(b.plant_id AS CHAR), 'organization_id', b.organization_id, 'transaction_no', b.transaction_no) AS j
  FROM batch b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
   AND b.organization_id = (SELECT h.organization_id FROM sm_item_disassembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_DPentry.data.idaId}})
   AND b.batch_number IN (SELECT l.batch_number
                            FROM sm_item_disassembly_tlm8ve69_sub l
                           WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_item_disassembly_id = {{node:code_node_DPentry.data.idaId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0
                             AND TRIM(COALESCE(l.batch_number, '')) NOT IN ('', '-', 'Auto-generated batch number')
                          UNION
                          SELECT TRIM(l.batch_number)
                            FROM sm_item_disassembly_tlm8ve69_sub l
                           WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_DPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_item_disassembly_id = {{node:code_node_DPentry.data.idaId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0
                             AND TRIM(COALESCE(l.batch_number, '')) NOT IN ('', '-', 'Auto-generated batch number'))
 ORDER BY b.id
